description: a JOIN across two tables reports neither pkey nor ptable, even though each side of the join has its own primary key -- a client cannot safely target a single row of either table from this result set

body: SELECT pk{{SQLTESTID}}.id, pk2{{SQLTESTID}}.id FROM pk{{SQLTESTID}} JOIN pk2{{SQLTESTID}} ON pk{{SQLTESTID}}.id = pk2{{SQLTESTID}}.pk_id
